pages.text: Many moves leave a $(bold)status$() on what they hit. Hover a move in your menu and its $(warn)Inflicts$() line names it.$(br2)Mobs use them on you too: a vampire's bite makes you bleed, and a Stand user's barrage ends in a stagger.

pages.title: Stunned
pages.text: $(bold)Stun I$(): slowed, hitting half as hard, and only moves that answer a blow still work.$(br2)$(bold)Stun II$(): held in place with no moves at all.$(br2)Players are never stunned past $(num)1.5$() seconds.

pages.title: Bleeding
pages.text: Each new wound deepens it, up to three times. When it runs out it lands at once: $(num)3$(), $(num)6$() or $(num)9$() damage.

pages.title: Burning
pages.text: Stacks up to three times, burning $(num)1$(), $(num)1.5$() or $(num)2$() a second for $(num)5$() seconds. Each stack starts it again.$(br2)$(warn)Water$() and Fire Resistance put it out.

pages.title: Resistance
pages.text: A mob stunned again within $(num)3$() seconds of its last stun takes only half of it.$(br2)Bosses such as the Wither, the Warden and the Ender Dragon take half of every status.
